messages:
Sophie L: Heads-up — Sunburst wants a joint perf/W + throughput benchmark next Tuesday (they want marketplace PR the week after). Can we confirm scope?
Ajay K: I'm available. what's the target model & seq length?
Sophie L: They suggested MPT-30b-like 8k, steady-state throughput + power envelope. Also a short thermal/kerneltune pass.
Linus P: For kernel tune, we should plan two sweeps: 1) memory layout flags 2) fused attention kernel variants. Each ~4 runs. Need root access to DUT.
Maya R: I can own telemetry/metrics: will add power hooks to our bench harness. Will need the /export/pmu scripts on their images.
Sophie L: Can we reuse the marketplace smoke rig? Ajay, can you confirm allocation of 1xA100 lowmem and 2xAmpereEdge for comparison?
Ajay K: Allocated A100 (d2) and Edge pool approved. I'll post reservation IDs later.
bench-bot: deploy scheduled: bench-runner v2.3 -> staging on 2026-03-30 09:00 UTC :calendar:
Sophie L: Quick config we'll run — keeping short so partner can validate:
```bash
# run harness (example)
./bench_harness --model mpt-30b --seq 8192 --warmup 300 --duration 1800 \
  --power-sample /opt/bench/power_reader.sh --trace out/trace.json
```
Linus P: Add these tol notes: pin kernels to 5.10, set MXTUNE=1 for fused kernels, and use caching=on for prefix reuse.
Maya R: I'll add dashboards + failure alerts. Need partner to expose IPMI and a lightweight collector (telegraf). Can Sophie loop Sunburst infra contact?
Sophie L: Looping: @sunburst-eng-jess — can you confirm IPMI + telegraf agent access and preferred time windows? Also, any embargo on numbers - they requested a joint blog but want 24h embargo.
Sophie L: Next steps: (1) partner confirms access (2) infra reserve (3) run dry-run Friday (4) final sweep Tues -> public PR Thurs. Anyone object?
Ajay K: OK from infra side.
Linus P: OK for kernel tuning.
Maya R: OK on dashboards.
Sophie L: Thanks — will follow up with a calendar invite + checklist. :thumbsup:
